languageData.TentacleIngest.label: ingest tentacle
languageData.TentacleIngest.description: Ingests the selected Amor Squirmer into the Host.
languageData.TentacleExpel.label: expel tentacle
languageData.TentacleExpel.description: Expels an Amor Squirmer tentacle from the Host.\n\nWARNING: This is dangerous if the pawn runs out of stored tentacles!
languageData.TentacleTransfer.label: transfer tentacle
languageData.TentacleTransfer.description: Transfer an Amor Squirmer tentacle from one Host to another. With a sloppy kiss.\n\nWARNING: This is dangerous if the pawn runs out of stored tentacles!
languageData.SquirmerAssistance.label: squirmer assistance
languageData.SquirmerAssistance.description: Overwork and make the Squirmers inside the Servant pull from their orifices into extra working hands. Work speed is increased while active, consuming one stored tentacle about every twenty seconds. Cast again to turn it off.
languageData.AmorTentacleJump.label: tentacle jump
languageData.AmorTentacleJump.description: Leap to a distant location using the Squirmers stored inside the Knight as assistance. Costs one stored tentacle.
languageData.AmorTentacleJump.verbProperties.label: jump
languageData.QueenSummonAmorDrone.label: summon Amor Drone
languageData.QueenSummonAmorDrone.description: Birth an Amor Drone to fight for the Queen. Costs three stored tentacles.
languageData.RogueInvisibility.label: invisibility
languageData.RogueInvisibility.description: Toggle invisibility. While active, it consumes one stored tentacle every ten seconds. Cast again to turn it off.
languageData.SeducingKiss.label: seducing kiss
languageData.SeducingKiss.description: Plant an Amor Squirmer in the target, weakening and incapacitating them for a short time.
languageData.PlacatingKiss.label: placating kiss
languageData.PlacatingKiss.description: Use the Amor Squirmers inside the Host to calm a pawn and end their mental break. Costs one stored tentacle.
languageData.IncubateAmorBroodMotherEgg.label: Incubate Amor Brood Mother egg
languageData.IncubateAmorBroodMotherEgg.description: Begin the process of incubating a massive Amor Brood Mother egg.
languageData.BirthAmorBroodMotherEgg.label: Lay Amor Brood Mother egg
languageData.BirthAmorBroodMotherEgg.description: Begin laying a massive Amor Brood Mother egg.\n\nWARNING: This process is very debilitating for the Host. Make sure she gets somewhere safe, quickly!
languageData.TCumSpray.label: cum spray
languageData.TCumSpray.description: Expel tentacle slime-cum from the Host's mouth in a long-range cone. Puts out fires - and sometimes pushes pawns into sexual overdrive, where they force themselves on anyone nearby.
languageData.WarWombSpawnDrones.label: spawn Amor Drones
languageData.WarWombSpawnDrones.description: Birth three Amor Drones to fight for the War Womb. They automatically attack nearby enemies and shortly after being summoned.
languageData.WarWombCumBombardment.label: explosive cum bombardment
languageData.WarWombCumBombardment.description: Fire a mass of cum and tentacles to an area, dealing area damage and briefly impairing movement and sight, and making the target horny.
languageData.DefenderGuard.label: defender's bulwark
languageData.DefenderGuard.description: Reduce the Defender's incoming damage, and increase regeneration; nearby allies gain a smaller boost to those stats.
languageData.ValkyrieRally.label: valkyrie's rally
languageData.ValkyrieRally.description: The Valkyrie gains a boost to movement speed, manipulation, and psychic sensitivity; nearby allies gain a smaller boost to those stats.
languageData.AbilityTentacleUnbirth.label: crawl inside
languageData.AbilityTentacleUnbirth.description: Commands the Amor Squirmer to crawl inside the targeted Host, adding tentacle resources.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSquirmer.label: evolve into squirmers
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSquirmer.description: Evolve the Larva into a small handful of Squirmers. Inefficient, but if you need some and don't have Spawners available...
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveGrazer.label: evolve into grazer
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveGrazer.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Grazer, which can be raised for tentacle leather.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveProducer.label: evolve into producer
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveProducer.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Producer, which can be milked for tentacle resin.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSpawner.label: evolve into spawner
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveSpawner.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Spawner, which will in turn produce Amor Squirmers.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveStriker.label: evolve into striker
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveStriker.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Striker, which can assault enemies at close range.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveStinger.label: evolve into stinger
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveStinger.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Stinger, which can weaken and mind control enemies.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveBorer.label: evolve into borer
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveBorer.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Borer, which can penetrate solid rock.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveAbductor.label: evolve into abductor
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveAbductor.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Abductor, which can capture incapacitated victims.
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveHunter.label: evolve into hunter
languageData.AbilityLarvaEvolveHunter.description: Evolve the Larva into an Amor Hunter, which can shower enemies with chemical secretions.
languageData.GrabberLeap.description: Leap onto a target and attempt to attach to its eligible, unoccupied body part with the highest grab-success chance; target will be relentlessly fucked if successful, with a chance to strip relevant apparel. Success chance and strip chance depends on the target's armor and it's vacuum resistance.
languageData.GrabberLeap.label: striker leap
languageData.GrabberLeap.verbProperties.label: jump
languageData.ParaBarbs.description: Launch several venom-laced barbs that apply a small amount of Amor Paralytic Poison on hit.
languageData.ParaBarbs.label: venom barbs
languageData.StingerLatch.description: Leap onto an incapacitated pawn's head, using it's tentacles to fuck their brain and completely take control of them. The pawn feels no pain and is unusually alert, mobile, and dexterous. They will die when the Stinger's hold ends unless it is surgically removed.
languageData.StingerLatch.label: stinger latch
languageData.StingerLatch.verbProperties.label: latch
